input.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter, as the Agreement currently gives us no exit or data-return rights (Section 16.5 even cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). We can accept ninety days of transition assistance if six months is problematic.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.
